descriptor.name: City of Polokwane municipal Land Information / Polokwane Properties
descriptor.attribution: City of Polokwane Local Municipality GIS / Land Information Management / Polokwane Properties. Provider WGS84 output; complete returned polygon rings retained.
descriptor.licenceNote: Anonymous public access is verified. No explicit reusable licence was established; permission and attribution terms require second-pass review.
descriptor.scope: Municipal cadastral property records observed across the urban area. Bounded distributed discovery and five exact samples do not establish whole-city or municipality completeness. Rural gaps remain in the reviewed packet.

sourceClassification.authority: City of Polokwane Local Municipality GIS
sourceClassification.basis: Official municipal GIS separates Land Information from Valuation Roll and Town Planning. The exact Land_Information_Management layer is Polokwane Properties, a polygon layer with SG21/SG32 survey keys and PARCEL_NO, PORTION, PARCEL_TYPE, ERF_NUMBER and PORTION_NUMBER cadastral schema. Five known SG32 records return full polygons. This supports cadastral property records rather than listings, proposed developments or a planning overlay; it does not establish legal-title or currentness semantics.

coverage.basis: Discovery claim checked against copied hash-verified five-area first-party probes and live exact SG32 reads. Qualification samples do not establish citywide completeness; no 13-cell coverage claim is made.
